Name: Holiday Sales 1.6
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Holiday Sales Continued[/b][/size]
Shopkeepers don't close for festivals out of town anymore![/center]

[line]

[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]
This is a continuation of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13050]Holiday Sales[/url] by [b]atravita[/b], updated for [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/b] and rebuilt so it [b]no longer needs AtraCore[/b]. All credit for the original idea and design goes to atravita. This version is a port, with a few bug fixes.

In atravita's words, it never really made sense that Pelican Town would shut down when, say, Ridgeside had a festival. By default, this mod keeps stores "in town" open when mod maps have festivals. It also works the other way around: doors on mod maps stay open when the town has a festival.

Or keep them open during [i]all[/i] festivals, if you're feeling mean like that.

[size=4][b]What it affects[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Shop doors (Pierre's, Clint's, Marnie's, etc.)[/*]
[*]Phone calls to shops[/*]
[*]The Help Wanted daily quest on Pierre's board[/*]
[*]The trash bear, Ginger Island visitor schedules, gifting and tool pickup messages[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
Run the game once to generate [font=Courier New]config.json[/font], or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[list]
[*][b]Closed[/b]: vanilla behavior. Stores close on festival days.[/*]
[*][b]Map Dependent[/b] (default): stores close only if they're in the same region as the festival. All of Pelican Valley counts as one region, so vanilla festivals still close vanilla shops. Mod areas with their own location context, or maps named [font=Courier New]Custom_<ModName>_<Map>[/font], count as their own region.[/*]
[*][b]Open[/b]: stores never close for festivals.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Note:[/b] you still can't enter the festival's own map before the festival starts. For example, during the Egg Festival you can't reach Pierre's, because it's in Town. Shops elsewhere (like Marnie's) will be open in [b]Open[/b] mode.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15[/*]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Optional: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].[/*]
[*][b]Remove the original Holiday Sales[/b] if you have it installed.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]
Delete the folder from your Mods directory. The mod adds nothing to your save.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works on Windows, macOS and Linux.[/*]
[*]Works in single player, multiplayer and split-screen.[/*]
[*]Should be compatible with most other mods. Made with festival mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] in mind.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What changed from the original[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6.15.[/*]
[*]No longer requires AtraCore.[/*]
[*]The daily quest fix keeps the game's own behavior and only adds the quest back when an out-of-town festival removed it.[/*]
[*]Fixed maps named [font=Courier New]Custom_<ModName>[/font] never matching their mod's festivals.[/*]
[*]Fixed a possible freeze with mods whose location contexts point at each other.[/*]
[/list]
[line]
